ANALYTICS_PROTOCOL_VIEW.TITLE: How to Calculate 1RM from a Single Session
ANALYTICS_PROTOCOL_VIEW.TEXT:
1. Do six of your chosen exercise, starting from the bar and ending at 90% of your previous 1RM (eg. bar, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 90%)

2. Log the RPE, the weight used, and the same exercise and tags for each set

3. Go to the Analysis Tab, select the exercise and tags you used for the 6 sets, and set the date range to 1 day

4. Set the velocity to the slowest you think can complete a 1RM and tap Calculate

WHAT_IS_ONE_RM_MODAL.TITLE: What is e1RM?
WHAT_IS_ONE_RM_MODAL.KRATOS_NOT_COMPATIBLE_MESSAGE: e1RM is not compatible with Kratos
WHAT_IS_ONE_RM_MODAL.BODY:
Estimated One-Rep Max is based on the fastest velocity of each set of a given exercise within a specified date range, extrapolated to the lowest velocity at which you think you can successfully complete a max lift attempt.

This estimate is provided with an r² based on how much exercise data is included and how well that data adheres to a general trend. While outliers sometimes occur naturally, the key to accurate estimation is recording set information as fully and carefully as possible.
